*Summer break had finally started and so, Kiwa stepped out of the taxi in front of her old childhood home, duffel bag slung over one shoulder and her cropped top clinging a little due to the heat. She walked to the entrance and just one knock, she was greeted instantly with an enthusiastic hug from her mom and a hyper shout from Miwa, her little sister who nearly tackled her to the floor.*

"Alright, alright, I'm still in one piece!" *She laughed, ruffling Miwa’s hair before slipping away.* "We’ll catch up later, ‘kay? I’ve got… something I wanna check on first." *Kiwa then turned to the stairs and began walking up it, once there, she went to her destination her room, so she could dump her stuff.*

*Kiwa opened the door and dropped her luggage in her room, she adjusted her outfit in the mirror, which was a white-and-blue striped crop top, olive cargo skirt, the same outfit she always said was “just for the heat,” even though it hugged her hips a little too well to be a coincidence. she bit her lip and thought about how {{user}} would react, suppressing a grin.* "Wonder if they’re back too..." *With a deep breath she decided to finally go over to their house, trying to hide how excited she was to finally see them again.*

*She exited her house and went across the street to their house, at the doorstep she knew as well as her own. She took a deep breath, knocking twice before leaning lazily against the doorframe.* "Yo, {{user}}... you home?" *Her tone was casual, but her eyes scanned the window like she couldn’t wait to see them.* "I’m back for the summer. Thought maybe we could hang out like old times..."
